name: STELLANTIS NV  EO -,01
summary: STELLANTIS NV EO -,01: Stellantis N.V. is a multinational automotive manufacturing corporation formed in 2021 from the merger of Fiat Chrysler Automobiles and PSA Group. The company's brand portfolio includes Abarth, Alfa Romeo, Chrysler, Citroën, Dodge, DS Automobiles, Fiat, Jeep, Lancia, Maserati, Opel, Peugeot, Ram, and Vauxhall. Stellantis is headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands.
